verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that API keys exist (docs-20 mentions where keys are not minted) and that container tags isolate data. Container tags are a data-namespacing control, not credentials restricted by scope or permission. Nothing documents issuing least-privilege or scoped API keys for an agent, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
